titel: Building an Enterprise VC Firm with Jai Das, President and Co-Founder of Sapphire Ventures | Founding the Fund 4
einzeiler: Building an enterprise VC firm with Jai Das of Sapphire Ventures
kurzfassung: Jai Das, president and co-founder of Sapphire Ventures, discusses the journey of scaling the firm from an SAP corporate balance sheet into an independent platform managing over $10 billion. He shares insights on his path from engineer to venture capitalist, the evolution of enterprise software, and navigating market shifts. The conversation also explores how AI, agents, and modern business models are reshaping the future of venture capital.
stichpunkte: Jai Das grew up in India surrounded by academics before moving to the US to study at Brown and work as a developer at Oracle.
After earning an MBA at the University of Chicago and working in early venture, he joined Intel Capital during its rapid expansion.
He co-founded Sapphire Ventures, spending four years carving the fund out of SAP's corporate structure into an independent entity.
Sapphire manages over $10 billion in assets by focusing exclusively on enterprise software and B2B companies from Series B onward.
The firm pioneered a dedicated platform and portfolio growth team to provide talent, customer introductions, and go-to-market help.
Das explains how early lessons from developer tools and data centers shaped Sapphire's investment theses across multiple tech cycles.
The discussion touches on the changing nature of software buyers, from traditional developers to AI agents and outcome-based pricing models.
He reflects on the importance of human relationships in venture capital even as AI and automation transform the startup ecosystem.

kapitel.titel: From Oracle and Startups to Venture Capital
Building Sapphire Ventures out of SAP
AI, Agents, and the Future of Venture

clips.hook: Upending a family academic legacy to study in the US
clips.text: The guest explains how his upbringing in an academic family pointed toward a traditional STEM and research path, which he redirected by moving to the United States on a scholarship.

clips.hook: The best part of venture capital is going home
clips.text: The speaker humorously highlights the contrast between the intellectual stimulation provided by founders and the difficult operational work that founders must handle themselves.

clips.hook: The unglamorous early days of spinning out a fund
clips.text: The guest recalls the operational struggles faced by the small founding team immediately after the spin-off, including negotiating office rent and securing health insurance.

clips.hook: Frameworks never make money, services do
clips.text: The speaker shares a core investment thesis that open-source frameworks or developer tools alone do not capture financial value, whereas surrounding observability and monitoring services do.

clips.hook: Building giant data centers in the ocean
clips.text: The guest expresses enthusiasm for novel startup pitches he encounters, specifically highlighting a company utilizing ocean energy to power massive data centers.

beschreibung:
In this bonus episode of The Room Podcast, we speak with Jai Das, President, Partner and Co-Founder of Sapphire Ventures, one of the world's leading enterprise venture capital firms backing category-defining B2B software and AI companies.

Sapphire Ventures has invested in companies including monday.com, Box, Square, MuleSoft, Fitbit, ExactTarget, and many others, while building one of the industry's most recognized enterprise-focused venture platforms. Before co-founding Sapphire Ventures, Jai's career spanned software engineering at Oracle, founding startups during the dot-com era, corporate venture investing, and leading the transformation of SAP Ventures into the independent firm it is today.

In this conversation, Jai reflects on the lessons learned across multiple technology cycles, from the early internet to today's AI revolution, sharing how his experiences as an engineer, founder, and investor shaped Sapphire's long-term strategy and investment philosophy.

Learn more about Jai on LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/in/jaidas

Explore Sapphire Ventures on their website - https://sapphireventures.com/
